Passion for Nature
Roidina Safari Lodge is a resort located near Omaruru, Namibia. We offer a tranquil oasis surrounded by pristine landscapes and fascinating wildlife.
Navigate to the next section
Roidina Safari Farm – Where Wildlife Meets Serenity
Roidina Safari Lodge is a place where every stay delights the senses and surrounds you with an authentic African atmosphere. Our team takes care of every detail, so you can relax, unwind, and fully enjoy your surroundings — including the peaceful presence of wild African animals that roam the farm and make every moment feel close to nature.
Conveniently located on the C33 road, just 20 km from Omaruru towards Kalkfeld and Otjiwarongo, Roidina Safari Lodge is the perfect place to pause, rest, and recharge on your journey between Swakopmund, Windhoek, and Etosha.
Learn More about our animals
Stay in Comfort. Experience the Wild.
Roidina Safari Lodge offers comfortable and spacious bungalows, and family rooms, each accommodating 2–5 guests. Each room has a kitchenette for self-catering, while the lodge also features a charming on-site restaurant for those who prefer to dine out. Day visitors are welcome at the lodge. Secure parking is available.
Guests can relax by the pool, enjoy a braai under the African sky, or explore the bush on guided walks, bird watching, and game viewing.  A private airstrip allows adventurous guests to arrive by plane or microlight, making the lodge a true safari escape.
